conjecture: There are universal C_dir < infinity and e_dir > 0 such that, if B_1,B_2 are finite-dimensional C*-algebras, P_1,P_2 are target t-projections, ||P_1+P_2-I|| <= t, and v_i:B_i->S_{P_i} are extended t-inclusions with target ambient defect at most t <= e_dir, then (x_1,x_2) |-> v_1(x_1)+v_2(x_2) is an extended C_dir*t-inclusion; bijectivity is asserted only if both v_i are bijective and both target cross-corners vanish.
